It plays an important role in calcium absorption and can help reduce inflammation. The body can get vitamin D through dietary sources and sunlight. However, very few foods naturally contain vitamin D, and it’s not always easy to find time to sit outside and soak up the sun, so supplements can help ensure that the body still gets what it needs.  
[Vitamin D](https://www.everydayhealth.com/vitamin-d/)supplements are available in two forms: D2 and D3. While both can help address a vitamin D deficiency, D3 is typically recommended because it’s slightly more effective than D2. Additionally, vitamin D3 is naturally produced in the body, whereas D2 is not, which is another reason why D3 is preferred.
